In [[geometry]], the '''augmented truncated cube''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''<sub>66</sub>}}). As its name suggests, it is created by attaching a [[square cupola]] ({{math|''J''<sub>4</sub>}}) onto one [[octagon]]al face of a [[truncated cube]].
